name: Knock Out
summary: Ready, aim, and clear the board! Knock Out is a fun and satisfying block-shooting puzzle game where every shot brings you closer to victory. Blast colorful blocks, topple clever structures, and clear every last piece to complete the level. Fire matching blocks to create explosive chain reactions. Knock down towers, break through obstacles, and watch satisfying physics-driven destruction unfold with every perfect shot. Each level presents a new puzzle to solve, challenging you to think ahead and make every move count. Simple to learn, hard to put down. Whether you're clearing rows of colorful blocks or bringing down giant constructions piece by piece, Knock Out! delivers quick, rewarding gameplay that keeps you coming back for more.
